info.name: F5 BIG-IP DNS - Lab (iControl REST)
info.description:
iControl REST calls for the DNS Management Portal F5 integration, for the LAB BIG-IP (BIG-IP VE 21.1.0.1). Set 'password' once (Current value). Every request uses the token header from the collection and signs in automatically when the token is missing or expired.

Postman: Settings > General > turn off 'SSL certificate verification' for the lab self-signed certificate (never for production).

Run order for a full test: 00 > 01 > 02 (create partition) > 04 > 05 > 06 > 07 > 09 > 11 > 12 > 99. Section 04 onwards needs the DNS (GTM) module provisioned (01 > Provisioned modules).

exec: // Signs in once and re-signs in when the token is about to expire, so every request just works.
if (!password) { console.warn("Set the collection variable 'password' (Current value) first."); return; }
if (err || res.code !== 200) { console.error("F5 auto-login failed", err || res.code); return; }

variable.description: Set the Current value in Postman; keep the Initial value empty so it is never exported
Device group name for config sync
Set the Current value in Postman

item.name: 00 Auth (token)
item.description: Token sign-in. Run 'Login' once, or just run any request: the collection signs in automatically when the token is missing or expired. Tokens last 1200 s by default.

request.description: Returns token.token; the test script stores it in the collection variable 'token'.

exec: console.log("F5 token stored, valid for " + body.token.timeout + " s");

request.description: Shows timeout and expiry of the current token.
Sets the token lifetime in seconds (max 36000).
